description: Nearest-site regions of a set of points: the plot is split into one region per site, each region being every spot that is closer to its site than to any other site (a catchment or service area: which store, depot, sensor or office is nearest). Regions come from a Delaunay triangulation and its Voronoi cells (d3-delaunay, with delaunator and robust-predicates), clipped to the sites' extent plus a margin, with nice axis ticks in the data's own units. Each region is filled with a light colour by group (a legend names every group, never colour alone) or with one light fill and a visible outline when there are no groups; the site is a dot, and its label sits under the dot when the region is wide enough for it (otherwise the label is hidden; the full label is in the region's tooltip and in the table). Static SVG, no script, scaled to its container. The hidden table lists every site with x, y, group, value and its share of the area. The aria label gives the number of sites, the number of groups and the site with the largest region. Motion-ready: each region reads --p through a --k so a motion_timeline track on p fades the regions in one after another; the standalone render is the finished picture.
